issues.where: lower-left foreground, below and left of the storm eye (pair-04-b crops D and I)
issues.what: A warm, sculpted billow has become a much darker, cooler streak. This loses the sunlit fold and the separation between the overlapping clouds.
issues.fix: Bring back the warm raking light and fine ridges on the raised fold; keep the deep black in the valleys around it.

issues.where: diagonal cloud deck between the eye and the horizon (pair-04-b crops A, B, F and H)
issues.what: Long blue-gray and nearly black streaks interrupt the lighter cream deck. The distant layers look flatter and more sharply striped than the target.
issues.fix: Soften and lift the long dark streaks, and restore the pale, broken cloud texture between the eye and the limb.

issues.where: clear sky left of the disc and along the Milky Way at right (pair-02-b crops B–H)
issues.what: There are too many conspicuous bright points, even in the target’s darker sky. The extra stars compete with the galactic dust and make the blacks feel less quiet.
issues.fix: Dim or thin the added bright points, preserving the target’s dark gaps and the color and structure of the Milky Way.

issues.where: sunlit upper-left and lower-left limb, crops B and D
issues.what: The upper-left halo reads cooler and grayer than the target’s warm glow. The lower-left halo spills a little farther into the dark sky.
issues.fix: Warm the upper-left halo and contain the lower-left spill while retaining the soft falloff and crisp disc edge.

issues.where: moon, its cast shadow, and the surrounding mid-disc belts, crop A
issues.what: The moon and its shadow sit a little high and left. The shadow’s far edge is harder, and the adjacent cream belts show slightly less fine separation.
issues.fix: Set the moon and shadow marginally down and right, soften the shadow’s distal edge, and recover the fine pale and blue cloud filaments.

issues.where: dark right limb and polar falloff, crops C, E and I
issues.what: Isolated cool blue marks and faint bands show through the terminator more distinctly than in the target. The polar cap is also a little less textured.
issues.fix: Subdue the blue marks into the near-black falloff and restore subtle cloud relief on the lit side of the upper cap.

issues.where: storm eye and immediate inner and lower-left rims, crops A, B, F and G
issues.what: The eye’s position and warm light direction match, but the smallest orange filaments and the warm-to-dark separation on the lower rim are slightly muted.
issues.fix: Recover the fine amber filaments and separate the lit rim from the brown interior without lifting the black core.

issues.where: diagonal blue limb and sky above it, crops C and H
issues.what: Extra bright stars make the black sky and faint Milky Way busier, and the blue fringe across the middle-to-right horizon reads slightly more outlined.
issues.fix: Reduce bright point contrast and feather the blue fringe into the sky, keeping the horizon angle and warm-to-cool transition.

issues.where: lower-right storm folds around the blue flashes, crop E
issues.what: The flashes are in the right places, but the surrounding dark folds have slightly less fine definition.
issues.fix: Recover low-level cloud relief selectively around the blue pockets without lifting the whole lower-right corner.
